user.title: Set up Life Events
user.description: Track birthdays, anniversaries and (optionally) deceased loved ones. You can manage everything from the Life Events cards afterwards.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Life Events is already set up. Only one instance is needed.

add_event.name: Add event
add_event.description: Add a birthday, anniversary or deceased entry.

update_event.name: Update event
update_event.description: Update an existing event. Only the provided fields are changed.

import_events.name: Import events
import_events.description: Bulk import events from a CSV or JSON string.

export_events.name: Export events
export_events.description: Export all events as a CSV or JSON string.

set_fixed_attributes.name: Set fixed attributes
set_fixed_attributes.description: Replace the schema of fixed (required) custom attributes. Normally set via the Manage card's editor, not called directly.

get_fixed_attributes.name: Get fixed attributes
get_fixed_attributes.description: Return the current schema of fixed (required) custom attributes.

link_marriage.name: Link marriage
link_marriage.description: Marry two existing persons, symmetrically linking both records with a shared anniversary date.

unlink_marriage.name: Unlink marriage
unlink_marriage.description: Divorce: symmetrically clear the marriage link on both sides.
